rules.shovel: CrateDigChanceEffect.value/10000; killing hitbox sets max chance, main rolls chance/(1+itemsSpawnedThisWave) before normal loot; excludes always_drop_consumables. No Luck or crate-chance modifier. This is a regular crate, not a new excavation site.
rules.sites: Sum all periodic item effects when wave%period==0 plus native character dig_sites and periodic dig_sites_every_x_waves. One progress delta per tick whenever any live player intersects. Progress pauses when empty and survives reentry. Uniform random5..6seconds, then one ordinary crate; retain completed scene until room cleanup.
rules.placement: Initial clamped random position, then up to30 better-score attempts; score=min(distanceToCenter/400,eachDistance/350). Edge margin150sourcepoints.
rules.unlock: Lifetime dig_sites_dug_up >=10 unlocks Shovel. Dig Site item unlocked by Archaeologist win.
rules.coopAdaptation: The original uses a Steam-profile-wide completion counter. Online profiles credit each alive participant digging at completion once; spectators and distant peers receive no credit. This mapping is an explicit online-coop adaptation, not a measured native per-player rule.
